title: Building uReview, Uber’s Multi-Agent Code Review Engine — Will Bond & Ameya Ketkar, Uber
talk_summary: Uber built uReview as a multi-generator code review service with post-processing, team-specific customizations, and heavy observability. They report that outcome telemetry and risk-based routing improved quality/cost versus a naive implementation.

takeaways.technique: Post-process and deduplicate AI review comments
takeaways.what_they_do: Run multiple review generators, then rate, categorize, filter, and deduplicate comments so engineers only get high-confidence actionable comments.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we run through a number of steps in the post-processing where we both rate, categorize, filter, and deduplicate comments

takeaways.what_they_do: Track whether comments are addressed, sentiment/category of replies, and agent trajectories/tool calls; feed that back into prompts and runtime tuning.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We started tracking things like address rate. So basically when a U review comment is made, does the developer go and actually address the comment?
takeaways.numbers: 25,000 comments/week; 10% feedback; 4% of PRs negative; 67% addressal; ~75% high-severity addressed; 60% cost down and 70% quality/accuracy up vs naive

takeaways.what_they_do: Use risk profile and complexity to decide which generator/model/review depth runs; not all code gets the same review.
takeaways.evidence_quote: take factors like the risk profile and the complexity of a code change and factor that in when deciding how we're going to run a code review

takeaways.technique: Team-specific review rules co-located with code
takeaways.what_they_do: Co-locate team review customizations next to code, piggyback ownership routing, and support AI linters/custom agents linked to knowledge bases and past PRs.
Tell the review agent what not to waste turns doing and profile trajectories to tune runtime; code review must finish in a specific time span.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we need to have guardrails for the agent. So we need to tell the agent what not to waste turns doing.

takeaways.technique: Separate inner-loop review accuracy from outer-loop human review
takeaways.what_they_do: For agent-authored code, review accuracy must be higher to avoid fix-review-fix cavitation; suppress nit floods and move humans to architecture/product review.
takeaways.evidence_quote: with the inner loop, our accuracy needs actually need to go up
